versions.changelog:
Pet Boarding Manager 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launch of a comprehensive pet boarding management system for providers.
- Manage pet and owner profiles, reservations, daily care logs, and billing.
- Supports multiple pet types (dogs, cats, others) and various service packages.
- Enables fee calculation and detailed daily care/activity tracking.
- Stores data locally for owner, pet, reservation, care, and billing records.
- Includes bilingual documentation (English/Chinese) and example workflows.
